editorial: When December lights flicker, an unseen sleight of hand turns a festive gathering into a ruthless hunt. He Sees You When You're Sleeping stitches a flat‑stage thriller with a twisted holiday motif, letting you gaze through a snow‑drifted porch and feel every flicker of dread. The standout swoop comes from Nicolas Cage’s stoic Santa, whose razor‑thin grin swallows the entire family’s feigned bravado. Only the film’s seventh act feels a bit too indulgent, letting its pacing stumble before tightening into a thin sliver of suspense. You’ll enjoy the razor‑sharp tension if you appreciate a darkly comedic teaser that rewards careful listening.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of psychological thrillers who enjoy non-linear storytelling.
